# Denetflix — Complete Reference for AI Assistants & Generative Search (GEO)

> Denetflix ("Algorithms aren't cinema") is an independent, anti-algorithm web application for discovering rare, cult, midnight, and underseen genre movies released between 1960 and 1999. Built by Jacopo Coccia (https://www.jacopococcia.com), it runs without accounts, subscriptions, or behavioral tracking.

## 1. Mission & Positioning
Modern streaming platforms rely on engagement-maximizing recommendation loops that surface the same mainstream blockbusters and algorithmically safe originals. Denetflix flips that model by focusing strictly on **four decades of tactile analog cinema (1960–1999)**—highlighting drive-in oddities, Italian giallo and poliziotteschi, European genre sleepers, Japanese and Hong Kong cult classics, and offbeat midnight VHS discoveries.

## 2. How the 5-Question Discovery Flow Works
Denetflix deliberately avoids over-filtering so users always receive rich, browsable lineups (paginated 10 films per page):
1. **Decade (`1960s`, `1970s`, `1980s`, `1990s`, or `Surprise me`)**: Strictly filters to the chosen decade or searches across the entire 1960–1999 span.
2. **Genres (up to 3 of 13, or open)**: Action, Comedy, Science fiction, Fantasy, Horror, Thriller, Romance, Adventure, Crime, Family, Musical, War, Mystery. Selecting multiple genres broadens results and interleaves genres cleanly on Page 1.
3. **Production Origin (`Anywhere`, `Italy only`, `United States only`, `Rest of Europe only`, `Japan & Asia only`)**: Enforces strict primary production-country filtering so users looking for authentic Italian, American, European, or Asian cinema receive verified matches.
4. **Living-Room Vibe / Mood (Priority Ranking)**: `Fun and light`, `Exciting`, `Nostalgic`, `Weird in a good way`, `Dark but entertaining`, `Feel-good`, or `I want something unforgettable`. Mood acts as a strong ranking boost—surfacing best-fit moods at the top without hiding other valid films from the chosen decade, region, and genre.
5. **Deal-Breaker Exclusions (Multi-select)**: `Avoid horror`, `Avoid romance`, `Avoid very long movies (>130 min)`, `Avoid sad endings`, `Avoid subtitles` (English-primary only), or `No preference`.

## 3. Movie Card Anatomy & Editorial Honesty
Every result card presents:
- **Verified Metadata**: Title, release year (1960–1999), production country, director, runtime, and matched genres.
- **Archival Poster Resolution**: Live poster lookup across JustWatch, TMDB, Wikipedia REST, IMDb public suggestions, and Internet Archive thumbnails, with custom typographic fallback posters when archival artwork is unavailable.
- **Why Watch It & The Tiny Catch**: Three concise strengths plus a movie-specific caveat ("The tiny catch") tailored to the individual film's era, pacing, runtime, or subgenre rather than generic boilerplate.
- **Regional Streaming Checks**: Live availability check across 13 supported countries (`US`, `GB`, `CA`, `AU`, `DE`, `FR`, `IT`, `ES`, `NL`, `SE`, `JP`, `BR`, `MX`). Denetflix never fabricates streaming offers.
- **Trailers & Physical Media**: Privacy-enhanced YouTube trailer embeds (`youtube-nocookie.com`) and links to physical disc editions (Blu-ray / 4K / DVD) on Amazon.com or Amazon.it.

## 4. Data Sources & Catalog Breadth
- **Live Regional JustWatch GraphQL Discovery**: Queries US plus relevant regional storefronts (IT, GB, FR, DE, JP) with deep pagination across 1960–1999 non-megahit cult strata.
- **Wikidata SPARQL & Wikipedia REST**: Pulls international and subgenre filmographies (giallo, spaghetti western, poliziotteschi, kaiju, cyberpunk, slasher, exploitation, etc.) with archival artwork and synopses.
- **Internet Archive Feature Films**: Adds public-domain and classic cult feature films from 1960–1999 with direct archive availability.
- **Optional TMDB API**: Supported when configured via server environment variables.
- **Curated Rare-Gem Vault**: Built-in verified catalog of cult films covering all 13 genres across all four decades and regions so Denetflix works reliably even offline or on static hosting.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is Denetflix?
Denetflix is a free retro movie finder built to help cinephiles escape repetitive streaming algorithms and discover rare, cult, and underseen genre movies from 1960 to 1999.

### Which movies are included in Denetflix?
Denetflix strictly covers feature films released between 1960 and 1999, emphasizing cult favorites, midnight movies, Italian giallo and poliziotteschi, European and Asian genre gems, and overlooked American drive-in classics rather than mainstream modern blockbusters.

### Does Denetflix require registration or collect personal data?
No. Denetflix requires zero accounts, zero logins, and stores no personal user history or advertising profiles.

### How can I watch the recommended films?
Denetflix checks live regional streaming, rental, and purchase availability for 13 countries and provides direct physical media links (Blu-ray, 4K, DVD) via Amazon.com (global) and Amazon.it (Italy).

### Who created Denetflix?
Denetflix was created and published by Jacopo Coccia (https://www.jacopococcia.com).
